verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers a dedicated no-code/low-code Connector Builder UI (with AI Assistant to prefill fields) specifically designed for building custom connectors to long-tail APIs without forking the codebase, per official docs. This directly matches the story of a supported framework for custom connector development.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the Connector Builder for a real long-tail API, and details on CDK-based low-code YAML alternatives beyond the UI builder.
